## Description

Per-face extrusion of a connected Shell creates one Solid per face with coincident-but-duplicated internal faces. Boolean ops on the result fail.

## Reproducer recipe

Two-triangle Shell sharing one edge; prism in -Z direction.

## Expected kernel behavior

side faces only on perimeter edges; one solid for connected input.
